question: What is the smallest fixed FP16 tetrahedral 3D LUT that compiles the reversible generic density-to-print interpretation while preserving bounded output, topology and inverse-density fidelity on an independent interior grid?
selection_rule: Select the first candidate in selection_order that passes every automatic gate; if none pass, close without adding a size, changing interpolation, weakening precision or clipping.
allowed_after_pass: retain one versioned compact generic print-LUT bundle for deterministic profile compilation
benchmark the selected LUT in a separately frozen canonical CPU runtime
forbidden: change candidate sizes, interpolation, precision, audit grid or thresholds after scoring
clip LUT nodes or interpolated outputs
treat the generic witness as measured print, stock, process or scanner calibration
photographic fitting, preference promotion or production-default change

branch_rule.pass: Retain the smallest passing FP16 LUT bundle and open one canonical runtime/parity audit.
branch_rule.fail: Keep the exact analytic forward/inverse pair and close LUT compilation without capacity rescue.

claim_ceiling: Compact deterministic approximation evidence for one generic explicit density-to-print equation family; not measured film/print/scanner calibration, photographic quality or product promotion.
